citation: docs/mip/0010-api-for-other-tools.md, sections 2 and 5; proto/muster_api.proto, its header's Requests and answers
why: Every request carries a correlation id the client chooses and its answer repeats, and a request the daemon does not know is refused with a code rather than ending the connection. That is what lets a client written for a later minor talk to an earlier daemon, so it holds for every request and is pinned here once. Each case is a conversation in protobuf's canonical JSON; docs/testing.md has the steps and tokens.

cases.name: an answer repeats the correlation id its request chose
cases.why: The id is the client's, so it can match an answer to its request without counting them; any string will do.

cases.name: a request the daemon does not know is refused as unsupported and the connection stays open
cases.why: A client of a later minor may send a request this daemon predates. It hears UNSUPPORTED, which it can act on, and goes on using the connection (the header, Requests and answers). A Request with no arm and an api request with none are both what such a request decodes to here.

cases.name: a topic the daemon does not know is refused as unsupported
cases.why: A topic added in a later minor is a number this daemon cannot serve, and a subscription that quietly left it out would read as a topic with nothing in it.
